purpose: Development calibration of conversation translation, not an unseen benchmark or accepted SFT export
selection: Agent-selected existing training conversations; originals unchanged. Deliberately includes source-quality and English-dependent tasks to expose failure modes.

cases.focus: Follow-up clarification without inventing a book title
Preserve equal mass when the user incorrectly challenges it
cases.source_caveat: Mass and volume distinction must survive translation
Keep the intentional unknown word nillion and every calendar assumption

cases.focus: Shift from spelling classification to units
cases.source_caveat: English words must remain quoted; translating the word puzzle itself can invalidate its answer

cases.focus: Procedural follow-up, capacities and numbered steps
cases.source_caveat: Source options are terse and the answer contains a jug spelling error; not automatically accepted supervision

cases.focus: Follow-up explanation of a technical expression
cases.source_caveat: Source uses not a planet without repeating dwarf planet distinction

cases.focus: Respect the follow-up constraint that Wikipedia cannot be blocked
cases.source_caveat: Source follow-up is weak and includes an unsupported generalization about distraction; calibration only

cases.focus: Preserve uncertainty rather than turn speculation into fact
cases.source_caveat: Source is speculative and somewhat agreeable; calibration only
